info.title: SatQuery AI
info.description:
Agentic vision-language analysis for satellite imagery.

**Schema version 1.0 — frozen.** Fields may be added within `1.0`; renaming,
removing or retyping any field requires a `2.0` bump. See `DOCS/API_CONTRACT.md`.

Phase 0: every endpoint returns schema-valid fixtures.

get.description:
Report service health.

``device.igpu_masked`` asserts that ``HIP_VISIBLE_DEVICES=0`` took effect. A
``false`` there is a red flag before any demo. ``leaked_gpu_permits`` is the
other one: a timed-out GPU tool whose thread is still on the card.

Return every tool, available or not.

Entries with ``available: false`` must be rendered as disabled rather than
hidden — the registry being real, and honest about what is not loaded yet,
is part of the story.

post.summary: Check whether the uploaded images can be analysed together
post.description:
Run ingestion and compatibility checks only — no tools, no GPU.

Call this on file select, before the user types: ``supported_tasks`` tells the
UI which questions to offer.

post.summary: Answer a question about one or two images
post.description:
Run the full pipeline and return the answer, its evidence and the trace.

A tool failure never produces a 5xx: it produces ``200`` with a ``DEGRADED``
or ``SKIPPED`` execution, a populated ``errors[]`` and a reduced confidence.
The single exception is a step the policy entry declares non-optional — only
the renderer today — because without rendered views there is no evidence to
reason over at all.

post.summary: Queue an analysis and watch it stream
post.description:
Accept the same body as ``/v1/analyze`` and return immediately.

The returned ``job_id`` *is* the eventual ``trace_id``, so the client can
address the trace before the pipeline has produced it.

get.description:
Return the job's current stage, progress and — once finished — its result.

A job the store no longer holds — evicted, or from before a restart — is
answered from its persisted trace when one exists: the trace store is the
durable half by design, and a client reconnecting after a server restart
should get its answer rather than a 404 it cannot tell from "never existed".

delete.description:
Ask a running job to stop. Best-effort, and honest about what that means.

The tool step in flight finishes — a worker thread cannot be killed — and no
further step starts. The job then ends with an ``error`` event carrying
``JOB_CANCELLED``, so an open events stream closes the way it would for any
other failure. ``202`` because the stop is requested, not yet done.

get.summary: Server-sent progress events for one job
get.description:
Stream the job's events, replaying everything that already happened.

A subscriber that connects late — the normal case, since the client needs the
``job_id`` from the 202 first — receives the buffered history before the live
tail, so the DAG can always be drawn from the ``plan`` event. One that
*reconnects* sends the last ``id:`` it saw and receives only the rest.

parameters.name: after

schema.description: Resume after this event id; the query form of Last-Event-ID.
schema.title: After

parameters.description: Resume after this event id; the query form of Last-Event-ID.

200.description: SSE stream. Event order is guaranteed: queued -> stage -> plan -> interleaved step_started/step_completed/artifact -> answer_delta* -> done|error. `done` and `error` are terminal and mutually exclusive.

get.description: Serve one artifact with immutable caching and conditional-request support.
Return the full audit trace for *trace_id*.

AnalyzeResponse.title: AnalyzeResponse
AnalyzeResponse.description:
``POST /v1/analyze`` 200 body.

``compatibility`` and ``resolved_task`` are duplicated at the top level so the
UI can render them without walking into the trace.

uncited_numeric_spans.title: Uncited Numeric Spans
uncited_numeric_spans.description: Numbers the CitationValidator could not resolve. Non-empty is a visible honesty signal — the frontend must render it.

template_fallback.title: Template Fallback
template_fallback.description: True when a deterministic template wrote the text.

Answer.title: Answer
Answer.description: The synthesised natural-language answer plus its honesty signals.

ApiError.title: ApiError
ApiError.description:
The error payload (API_CONTRACT §6).

``message`` and ``hint`` are user-facing and safe to display verbatim: never
leak file paths or stack traces into either.

ApiErrorResponse.title: ApiErrorResponse
ApiErrorResponse.description: Wire envelope for :class:`ApiError` — every non-2xx body has this shape.

id.title: Id
id.description: art_0, art_1, ... stable within a trace.

geo.description: None when the artifact is not georeferenced.

inline.title: Inline
inline.description: Payload for SCALARS/BBOX_SET/TEXT — avoids a second round trip.

ArtifactRef.title: ArtifactRef
ArtifactRef.description: A piece of evidence the pipeline produced. Immutable and cacheable forever.

ArtifactType.title: ArtifactType
ArtifactType.description: Kind of evidence produced by a tool (API_CONTRACT §2.5).

AuditTrace.title: AuditTrace
AuditTrace.description:
The full, replayable record of one analysis — the requirement-5 deliverable.

Top-level key order is frozen by API_CONTRACT §3.11 and is preserved here.

options.title: Options
options.description: JSON; only pair_type_hint and roles are honoured here.

detail.title: Detail
detail.description: One sentence, safe to display verbatim.

CheckResult.title: CheckResult
CheckResult.description: One compatibility check, including the ones that were skipped.

claim.title: Claim
claim.description: The exact span of answer text this supports.

Citation.title: Citation
Citation.description: Binds one claim in the answer text to one measured scalar.

CommonGrid.title: CommonGrid
CommonGrid.description: The grid both images were resampled onto for pairwise analysis.

overall.description: any FAIL -> FAIL; else any WARN -> PASS_WITH_WARNINGS; else PASS.

common_grid.description: None for SINGLE and for FAIL.

CompatibilityReport.title: CompatibilityReport
CompatibilityReport.description: Whether the inputs can be analysed together, and what it cost to get there.

caps_applied.title: Caps Applied
caps_applied.description: Names of any rule that clamped `overall`.

Confidence.title: Confidence
Confidence.description: Overall confidence and the components it was derived from.

igpu_masked.title: Igpu Masked
igpu_masked.description: Asserts HIP_VISIBLE_DEVICES=0 took effect. False is a red flag before a demo.

DeviceInfo.title: DeviceInfo
DeviceInfo.description: Accelerator state, as reported by the ROCm runtime.

ErrorItem.title: ErrorItem
ErrorItem.description: A failure that did not prevent a partial result.

params.title: Params
params.description: Exact effective parameters — the auditability payload.

scalars.title: Scalars
scalars.description: Merged into fact_sheet under this tool's namespace.

fallback_of.title: Fallback Of
fallback_of.description: Set when this execution replaced a failed tool.

Execution.title: Execution
Execution.description: The record of actually running one :class:`PlanStep` — the audit payload.

jobs_running.title: Jobs Running
jobs_running.description: Async jobs that have not reached a terminal event.

jobs_retained.title: Jobs Retained
jobs_retained.description: Jobs the in-memory store still holds, running or finished.

leaked_gpu_permits.title: Leaked Gpu Permits
leaked_gpu_permits.description: GPU tool threads that overran their timeout and are still running. Non-zero means the card is busy with work nobody is waiting for; past the process's limit, status is 'degraded'.

ImageRole.title: ImageRole
ImageRole.description: Role an image plays within its pair (API_CONTRACT §2.4).

InputContract.title: InputContract
InputContract.description: What a tool is willing to accept — the basis of capability matching.

id.title: Id
id.description: Stable within a trace: img_0, img_1, ... in upload order.

transform.title: Transform
transform.description: rasterio/GDAL affine 6-tuple [a, b, c, d, e, f].

bounds_native.title: Bounds Native
bounds_native.description: [minx, miny, maxx, maxy] in the raster's own CRS.

bounds_wgs84.title: Bounds Wgs84
bounds_wgs84.description: [min_lon, min_lat, max_lon, max_lat], lon first, EPSG:4326.

is_georeferenced.title: Is Georeferenced
is_georeferenced.description: crs is not None and transform is not None.

InputManifest.title: InputManifest
InputManifest.description:
Everything the ingestion layer learned about one uploaded image.

A field that is *inapplicable* is ``None``. A field that is *unknown* is
``None`` **and** carries an entry in :attr:`warnings`.

JobAccepted.title: JobAccepted
JobAccepted.description:
``POST /v1/jobs`` 202 body (API_CONTRACT §4.2).

``job_id`` *is* the eventual ``trace_id``: the id is minted before the
pipeline runs, so a client can address the trace before it exists.

JobStatusResponse.title: JobStatusResponse
JobStatusResponse.description:
``GET /v1/jobs/{job_id}`` 200 body (API_CONTRACT §4.3).

``result`` is populated only once ``status`` is ``succeeded``, ``error``
only once it is ``failed``; they are mutually exclusive, mirroring the
``done``/``error`` terminal SSE events.

Modality.title: Modality
Modality.description: Sensing modality of a single input (API_CONTRACT §2.3).

ModelInfo.title: ModelInfo
ModelInfo.description: One loadable model and its adapter.

Overall.title: Overall
Overall.description:
Aggregate compatibility verdict (API_CONTRACT §2.7).

Derivation: any FAIL -> FAIL; else any WARN -> PASS_WITH_WARNINGS; else PASS.

Plan.title: Plan
Plan.description: The tool DAG chosen for this query.

PlanStep.title: PlanStep
PlanStep.description: One node of the execution DAG, in topological order.

QuerySpec.title: QuerySpec
QuerySpec.description: The user's question, as received and as normalised.

Resampling.title: Resampling
Resampling.description: Resampling kernel used to build the common grid (API_CONTRACT §3.3).

ResolvedTask.title: ResolvedTask
ResolvedTask.description: What the query classifier decided the user is asking for.

description.title: Description
description.description: One line, shown in the capabilities panel.

scalars_schema.title: Scalars Schema
scalars_schema.description: JSON Schema of this tool's FactSheet contribution.

est_ms.title: Est Ms
est_ms.description: Typical wall time, for the progress bar.

fallback.title: Fallback
fallback.description: Name of the tool used when this one fails.

available.title: Available
available.description: Runtime: false when weights/backend are missing.

ToolSpec.title: ToolSpec
ToolSpec.description: One registry entry, as served by ``GET /v1/registry``.

ToolStatus.title: ToolStatus
ToolStatus.description: Outcome of a single tool execution (API_CONTRACT §2.8).

supported_tasks.title: Supported Tasks
supported_tasks.description: Capability matching over the registry — lets the UI grey out impossible questions.

ValidateResponse.title: ValidateResponse
ValidateResponse.description: ``POST /v1/validate`` 200 body (API_CONTRACT §4.5). No tools run, no GPU touched.

WarningItem.title: WarningItem
WarningItem.description: A non-fatal condition worth surfacing to the user.
